planets.name: WASP-4 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-4 with a 1.34-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: WASP-4 b was found in 2007 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-4. Its orbit and size follow Baştürk et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: WASP-4b
quotes.card: WASP-4b is an exoplanet, specifically a hot Jupiter, approximately 891 light-years away in the constellation of Phoenix.
